lifestream.description: Every Lifestream chat command: the plugin's own help list, plus the commands and setup tips it leaves out (inns, instances, stopping a trip, chaining).
lifestream.intro: Almost everything in Lifestream runs through one chat command, /li, followed by where you want to go. Its README doesn't list any of them. The full list is in the plugin's Help tab (type /lifestream), copied below as it appears in game.

extras.does: Cancel whatever Lifestream is doing, such as a trip stuck in a queue.
Go to your inn room on the world you're on. /li hinn goes back to your home world first.
Go to a specific city's inn. A number that's too high, like /li inn 99, prints the list.
Switch to that instance of the zone you're in, when the zone has instances. Handy for hunts and FATEs.
Go to your Free Company's Grand Company instead of your own, for FC seal turn-ins when the two differ.
Teleport to an aetheryte by part of its name, without changing world.
Put a shortcut after a world name and it runs once you arrive. Use a comma for anything longer, like an alias: /li bal, venue.
Give an Address Book entry or a Custom Alias route an alias and it becomes its own command.
Log out and back in as another of your characters on the same account.

tips: Names can be shortened. /li bal is Balmung and /li sapphire is Ul'dah's Sapphire Avenue Exchange. Worlds on your current data center are checked first.
Register your houses once in the House Registration tab (stand on the plot, then record the path to the door) so the estate commands walk you inside.
Install the optional vnavmesh plugin for the Grand Company commands to walk you to the counter. Without it they still teleport you to the right city.
Everything works in a macro, so a hotbar button for /li fc or /li mb is one click from anywhere.
Settings decide what a bare /li does (go home, open the world list, open settings, or nothing), whether data center travel is allowed, and whether to leave your party first.
You can also click an aethernet shard on the zone map to go there without typing anything.

simpletweaksplugin.description: Every Simple Tweaks chat command and the tweak it belongs to: /tweaks, /bait, /equipjob, /leaveduty, /levelingdungeon, /setoption, /usecollection and more.
simpletweaksplugin.intro: Type /tweaks to open the settings. Every other command belongs to a tweak and only works once you turn that tweak on there (search for the command's name). Most of them can be renamed in the tweak's own settings. The descriptions below are the plugin's own.

Open the highest level leveling dungeon.

artisan.description: Every Artisan chat command from the plugin's own help: open lists, macros and Endurance, start a list by ID, toggle automatic mode.
artisan.intro: All of Artisan's commands start with /artisan. Its README doesn't list them. This is the plugin's own help text, the same one Dalamud shows for the command in /xlhelp.

help.end: Toggles Automatic Action Execution Mode on/off.

gatherbuddy.description: Every GatherBuddy chat command from the plugin's own help: /gather, /gatherbtn, /gathermin, /gatherfish, /gathergroup and /gbc.
gatherbuddy.intro: GatherBuddy's main trick is /gather followed by an item name: it finds the nearest node, teleports you close and switches to the right gear. These are the plugin's own descriptions of each command.

inventorytools.description: Every Allagan Tools chat command from the plugin's own help: item lists, crafts, airships, submarines, retainer ventures, highlighting and more.
inventorytools.intro: Allagan Tools has a command for almost every window, handy for macros. Several have a short alias, shown in brackets. These are the plugin's own descriptions.

autohook.description: Every AutoHook chat command from the plugin's own help: turn it on and off, switch presets and bait, start casting, open the replay and fish data windows.
autohook.intro: AutoHook's commands are handy in fishing macros, for example switching preset and bait before you cast. These are the plugin's own descriptions.

lines: Start casting with your selected preset
Set custom preset by chat command -> /ahpreset presetName
Set Autogig preset by chat command -> /agpreset presetName
Switches fishing baits (by Name or ID)
Opens the Fish Data window. Add an optional fish name or id to open to that fish.

bossmod.description: Every BossMod (VBM) chat command from the plugin's own help: settings, replays, autorotation presets, AI mode and macro queueing.
bossmod.intro: BossMod runs from /vbm. Type a subcommand it doesn't know, like /vbm help, and it prints this same list in chat.

honorific.description: Every Honorific chat command: open the settings, enable or toggle titles, and force a custom title with its colour and glow.
honorific.intro: Honorific's settings window has a Commands section with these same commands. The title commands work well in gearset macros, so a title can change with your job.

lines: Enable, Disable, or Toggle a title on the current character.
Sets a title that will override all other configured titles.

extras.does: Pick a new random title, for characters set to use random titles.

autoretainer.description: Every AutoRetainer chat command from the plugin's own help: enable, MultiMode, relog to a character, sell items, expert delivery, armoire and dresser.
autoretainer.intro: All of AutoRetainer's commands start with /autoretainer, or the shorter /ays. This is the plugin's own help text, the same one Dalamud shows for the command in /xlhelp.
